title: Woh Ali Hota Hai
body:
wo Ali hota hai x 4
jo khudai ko chalaye woh Ali hota hai
kaam nabiyon ke jo aaye woh Ali hota hai
aik shab soney ki qeemat mein khuda ki marzi
shab e hijrat jo kamaye woh Ali hota hai
mil ke kaaba jo banaein woh nabi hotey hain
aur kabay mein jo aaye woh Ali hota hai
roz e mehshar jisay Allah adalat ke liye
apni kursi pe bithaye woh Ali hota hai
ban ke mehman jo meraj pe jaye woh nabi
haath jo aa ke milaye woh Ali hota hai
ek allah ke darbar mein sajday ke siwa
jo kahin sar na jhukaye woh Ali hota hai
aasmano se utari hui talwar ko bhi
waar karna jo sikhaye woh Ali hota hai
apne dushman ko bhi hijrat ke haseen bistar par
jo Muhammad nazar aaye woh Ali hota hai
hum ko bas itna pata hai keh jo hubdaron ka
qabr tak sath nibhaye woh Ali hota hai
khol kar khutbon se takhleeq ke parday khud jo
kun ke asbab bataye woh Ali hota hai
lawhe mahfooz se jibraele ameen ko akbar
wahi padhna jo sikhaye wo Ali hota hai
